Name: Silver's Fennec Foxes
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
We all knew and loved Neonify's fennec foxes, but I haven't been able to reach them for permission to update. So I thought I'd take a crack at making my own. So, ta-dah!

These fennec foxes can be bought from Marnie. They live in Barns, and they'll dig up omni geodes and artifact troves for you.

Enjoy!
